note: This is tù (vomit); tǔ is "to spit".

examples.zh: 孩子昨天晚上发烧，还吐了两次。
examples.en: The child ran a fever last night and also threw up twice.

examples.zh: 你想吐吗？我去拿水来。
examples.en: Do you feel like throwing up? I'll get you some water.

examples.zh: 坐船太久，他吐得很难受。
examples.en: After so long on the boat, he threw up and felt awful.

meaning: to give off, to brave; to pass oneself off as

senses.en: to give off, to brave; to pass oneself off as

note: 冒雨 = go out in the rain; 冒 + name/identity = impersonate.

examples.zh: 他紧张得头上冒汗了。
examples.en: He was so nervous that he broke out in a sweat.

examples.zh: 外面下雨，你别冒雨出去。
examples.en: It's raining outside, so don't go out in it.

examples.zh: 有人冒我的名字给朋友发消息。
examples.en: Someone used my name to send messages to my friends.

meaning: to, until (in a range, written style)

senses.en: to, until (in a range, written style)

note: Written style: 从……至……. Spoken: 到.

examples.zh: 本店营业时间从早上八点至晚上十点。
examples.en: Our opening hours are from 8 a.m. to 10 p.m.

examples.zh: 会议从一号至三号，请大家准时参加。
examples.en: The meeting runs from the 1st to the 3rd; please attend on time.

examples.zh: 从一月至三月，这里都很冷。
examples.en: From January to March it is cold here.

note: Casual spoken: 回头见 = see you later.

examples.zh: 我现在很忙，回头给你打电话。
examples.en: I'm a bit busy now; I'll call you later.

examples.zh: 这个问题回头再说，好吗？
examples.en: Let's come back to this question later, okay?

examples.zh: 你先走吧，我回头去找你。
examples.en: You go first; I'll come find you in a bit.

examples.zh: 袜子上有个洞，该扔了。
examples.en: There's a hole in the sock; time to throw it away.

examples.zh: 墙上的洞是谁弄的？
examples.en: Who made the hole in the wall?

examples.zh: 山里有一个大洞，晚上别进去。
examples.en: There's a big cave in the mountains; don't go in at night.

examples.zh: 听说你考上大学了，祝贺你！
examples.en: I heard you got into university. Congratulations!

examples.zh: 我们一起去祝贺他结婚吧。
examples.en: Let's go congratulate him on his wedding together.

examples.zh: 谢谢大家的祝贺，我很开心。
examples.en: Thank you all for your congratulations; I'm very happy.

meaning: to be close to, to approach

senses.en: to be close to, to approach

examples.zh: 我家靠近地铁站，上班很方便。
examples.en: My home is near a subway station, so commuting is easy.

examples.zh: 别靠近那条狗，它会咬人。
examples.en: Don't go near that dog; it bites.

examples.zh: 请靠近点，我听不见你说话。
examples.en: Please come closer; I can't hear you.

note: Covers many flat foods: 烧饼, 月饼, 饼干.

examples.zh: 早上我吃了一张饼，喝了杯牛奶。
examples.en: This morning I had a flatbread and a glass of milk.

examples.zh: 这家店的饼又香又脆。
examples.en: The flatbread at this shop is fragrant and crispy.

examples.zh: 你想吃饼还是米饭？
examples.en: Do you want flatbread or noodles?

meaning: to answer, to respond to a call or request

senses.en: to answer, to respond to a call or request

examples.zh: 我敲了半天门，里面没人应。
examples.en: I knocked for ages and nobody inside answered.

examples.zh: 他叫了我一声，我马上应了。
examples.en: He called me and I answered right away.

examples.zh: 他请我帮忙，我应了下来。
examples.en: He asked for my help and I agreed.

note: 签协议 = sign an agreement; 达成协议 = reach an agreement.

examples.zh: 两家公司昨天签了一项新协议。
examples.en: The two companies signed a new agreement yesterday.

examples.zh: 你看过这份协议吗？
examples.en: Have you read this agreement?

examples.zh: 他们对价格没达成协议。
examples.en: They didn't reach an agreement on the price.

meaning: to come into contact with, to deal with

senses.en: to come into contact with, to deal with

note: Used for people, things and ideas.

examples.zh: 我工作中常常接触各种病人。
examples.en: In my work I often come into contact with all kinds of patients.

examples.zh: 孩子太小，别让他接触手机。
examples.en: The child is too young; don't let him use a phone.

examples.zh: 你和他接触多了，就会了解他。
examples.en: The more you deal with him, the better you'll know him.

examples.zh: 在紧张的工作之中，他忘了吃饭。
examples.en: Caught up in tense work, he forgot to eat.

examples.zh: 他就在这群人之中。
examples.en: He is right among this group of people.

examples.zh: 在困难之中，朋友帮了我很多。
examples.en: In hard times, my friends helped me a lot.

examples.zh: 坏人看见警察，马上逃跑了。
examples.en: The thief saw the police and ran away at once.

examples.zh: 狗从院子里逃跑了，我们到处找。
examples.en: The dog ran out of the yard and we are looking everywhere.

examples.zh: 他想逃跑，但被抓住了。
examples.en: He tried to run away but was caught.

examples.zh: 医生正在分析检查结果。
examples.en: The doctor is analyzing the test results.

examples.zh: 你能帮我分析这个问题吗？
examples.en: Can you help me analyze this problem?

examples.zh: 他的分析很清楚，大家都同意。
examples.en: His analysis was clear and everyone agreed.

meaning: price paid, cost (of a choice or effort)

senses.en: price paid, cost (of a choice or effort)

note: 付出代价 = pay the price.

examples.zh: 为了这份工作，他付出了很大的代价。
examples.en: He paid a heavy price for this job.

examples.zh: 不管代价多大，我们都要完成。
examples.en: No matter the cost, we must finish it.

examples.zh: 经常晚睡的代价是白天没精神。
examples.en: The price of staying up late often is feeling drained by day.

examples.zh: 这部电影在海边拍摄。
examples.en: This film was shot in Yunnan.

examples.zh: 这里禁止拍摄，请把手机放好。
examples.en: Filming is not allowed here; please put your phone away.

examples.zh: 他们花了三个月拍摄这个广告。
examples.en: They spent three months shooting this ad.

examples.zh: 公司决定从下个月开始执行新规定。
examples.en: The company decided to enforce the new rules from next month.

examples.zh: 这个计划很好，但很难执行。
examples.en: The plan is good but hard to carry out.

examples.zh: 他严格执行医生的要求，每天吃药。
examples.en: He strictly follows the doctor's instructions and takes his medicine daily.

meaning: to call the police; to sound an alarm

senses.en: to call the police; to sound an alarm

note: Verb-object: 报了警 = called the police; in China the number is 110.

examples.zh: 我的包被偷了，快报警！
examples.en: My bag was stolen. Call the police!

examples.zh: 你看到了吗？有人已经报警了。
examples.en: Did you see? Someone has already called the police.

examples.zh: 遇到危险的时候，要马上报警。
examples.en: When you're in danger, call the police right away.

examples.zh: 小心，电话里的人可能是骗子。
examples.en: Careful, the person on the phone may be a scammer.

examples.zh: 他是个骗子，别相信他。
examples.en: He's a con man; don't believe him.

examples.zh: 我被骗子骗了两千块钱。
examples.en: A scammer cheated me out of two thousand yuan.

note: Colloquially 熊 also means "to scold" (他被老师熊了).

examples.zh: 动物园里有一只大熊。
examples.en: There is a big bear at the zoo.

examples.zh: 山里可能有熊，晚上别一个人去。
examples.en: There may be bears in the mountains; don't go alone at night.

examples.zh: 他昨天被老师熊了一顿。
examples.en: The teacher gave him a scolding yesterday.
